title: Held run's verdict line overflows the terminal (105 cells at width 100)
description:
dashProgressLine's fallback (watch_view.go:226, `return join(mid)`) is not bounded to the width it is given: when the progress bar cannot seat beside the answers it returns the answers bare, and a long health verdict ('● stopped: no process holds this run: the last one released it, or none has claimed it here') makes the line 103 cells at any width. The watch never shows the overflow because renderWatchFrame truncates every frame line to the pane width; the bare overview has no such pass, so the indented line prints at 105 cells and wraps in a 100-column terminal. The hold and its clearing command still show on their own wrapped lines, so nothing A2 names is hidden — it is the same wrap the kce finding was about, one line lower. Found while reproducing kce at base; kce's named fix (layout at width-2) does not and cannot fix it, and the seam is shared with the live watch, so I left it out of this tick.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go:226 — `return join(mid)` unbounded; internal/cli/overview.go renderOverview prints "  "+hl with no truncate: epic-hdh's line '  4/6 ticks · ● stopped: no process holds this run: the last one released it, or none has claimed it here' measures 105 cells at width 100
